prompt.model_desc: a Caucasian Brazilian man in his early 30s, athletic-lean build, medium-length dark brown hair slicked back and tied into a low bun, short groomed beard with moustache, defined eyebrows, serious calm expression
prompt.garment: a regular-fit long-sleeve raglan t-shirt in heavyweight 300gsm two-ply single jersey, {COR}, smooth dense knit with a soft subtle satin touch, raglan sleeves with a clean diagonal seam running from the neckline to the underarm (no shoulder seam), narrow ribbed crew neck about 2 cm wide, long sleeves ending in a plain turned hem at the wrist (no ribbed cuff), straight double-stitched bottom hem at the hip (no ribbed band), smooth on the inside (not fleece)
prompt.behavior: Fabric and construction: heavyweight 300gsm two-ply single jersey, smooth on both faces (no fleece inside) — dense and fully opaque, it drapes with body: a few soft vertical folds on the torso and gentle bunching along the forearms. Mostly matte, with a faint satin glow only on the highlights of the folds. The raglan seams run diagonally from the neckline to the underarm, flat and tonal; narrow ribbed crew neck lying flat; plain turned hems at the cuffs and bottom with double-needle topstitching. Movement: the raglan sleeve lets the shoulder move freely — when he lifts an arm the diagonal seam rotates smoothly with no pulling across the top of the shoulder; the heavy jersey forms soft rounded folds at the inner elbow.
prompt.fit: Fit on the model (size M on a 1.84 m, 84 kg man): regular fit — body length 72 cm ending at the hip; chest width 54 cm flat (about 108 cm around) with easy relaxed room; sleeve 68 cm measured from the base of the neckline to the cuff end, reaching the wrist bone with a little stacking; the rounded raglan shoulder slopes naturally with no seam at the shoulder point.
